name: Sauruven Hellwald
description: A Black Knight summoned in a planeswalkers' duel, who kills his friend Eumenes the minotaur.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Summoned to duel by rival planeswalkers, Sauruven kills his new friend Eumenes, sings the lament, and later kills the Stone Giant.
timeline.quote: the knight kills the minotaur, sings the lament for his friend, and later goes and kills the Stone Giant.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "The Lament , by S. M. Stirling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
